svg.title: Human LLM Council
svg.desc: Human LLM Council. An LLM that thinks and decides like one person, and runs on consumer-grade hardware. Four members sit round a table: the Scrutiniser, being built first, and the planned Designer, Coder and Orchestrator. Each lights in turn and passes a suggestion to the person at the head of the table, who decides. A typed line cycles: learns from my real answers to AI agents; scored on the times I overrule the agent; built for a 6 GB laptop GPU; data stays home; it suggests, and I still make the call. Preview: no model is trained on real data yet.
